Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🐔 Ingredients Chicken: • 1.1 lb (500 g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces • 1 egg • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp ginger powder • ½ tsp chicken bouillon • 5 tbsp cornstarch • 3 tbsp all-purpose flour Sauce: • 1.5 tbsp butter • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1.5 tbsp gochujang • 3 tbsp ketchup • 1 tbsp soy sauce • 2 tbsp light brown sugar • 1 tbsp honey • 2 tsp rice vinegar • 1 tsp sesame oil Garnish: • Toasted sesame seeds • Sliced green onions Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with the egg, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, ginger powder, and chicken bouillon. Mix well and let rest for 10 minutes. 2. Add the cornstarch and flour, then toss until evenly coated. 3. Fry at 320–330°F (160–165°C) until cooked through. Let rest for 2–3 minutes. 4. Fry again at 355°F (180°C) until golden and crispy. 5. Melt the butter and saute the garlic until fragrant. 6. Add the gochujang, ketchup, soy sauce, light brown sugar, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Cook until glossy. 7. Toss the chicken in the sauce until evenly coated. 8. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions. #chickenrecipes #koreanfood #popcorn #chicken #fyp

2 AM “Healthy” Buldak Dumpling Ramen 🍝😆 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 2 slices Baby Swiss cheese 1 slice American cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tbsp chili oil 1 Buldak sauce packet 1 Buldak seasoning packet 1 tbsp chopped green onions ¾–1 cup heavy cream 4–6 dumplings, cooked 6 cocktail sausages, cooked and scored Extra green onions, chili oil, and sesame seeds for garnish Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles for about half of the recommended cooking time, then drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the Baby Swiss cheese, American cheese, ketchup, mayonnaise, chili oil, Buldak sauce packet, Buldak seasoning packet, and chopped green onions. Stir everything together until the cheese melts and the mixture is smooth. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy and well combined. Add the partially cooked noodles and toss to coat. Let them finish cooking in the sauce for 2–3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and creamy. Top with the cooked dumplings and scored sausages. Finish with extra green onions, and drizzle of chili oil. Serve immediately while hot and creamy. . #buldak #buldakramen #food #Foodie #cook

A standout shoyu ramen spot in Tokyo. Their signature menu is the “Special Shoyu Ramen.” Built on a chicken-based broth blended with multiple soy sauces, the first sip brings out the richness of chicken oil, deep umami from the soy sauce, and a subtle sweetness. As you continue, the flavors finish clean and balanced. The charcoal-grilled chashu adds a gentle smoky aroma that naturally melts into the broth✨ The straight noodles hold the soup well, delivering its flavor all the way through each bite. The chashu comes in a variety of cuts, each prepared differently—from rich, fatty pieces to lighter, more delicate textures—letting you enjoy a contrast of juiciness and mouthfeel. [Ramen Sakurai 麺屋 さくら井] - Location: 2 Chome-15-27 Kamirenjaku, Mitaka, Tokyo, Japan - Hours: Mon & Sat 11:30 - 15:00 / 18:00 - 20:30, Tue/Thu/Fri 11:30 - 15:00, Sun 11:30 - 16:00 (Closed Wed) - Menu: Special Shoyu Ramen (¥2,000) #ramen #tokyoramen #shoyuramen #라멘

Creamy Cheesy Buldak Ramen 🍜🧀🔥 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 1 slice American cheese 1 slice Monterey Jack cheese 2 tbsp mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet Chili oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp chopped green onions ½ cup heavy cream or milk Cooked ramen noodles Toppings Fried egg Mini sausages Dumplings Extra green onions Extra chili oil Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the baby Swiss, American, and Monterey Jack cheese slices. Add the mayo, Buldak sauce, Buldak powder, chili oil, minced garlic, and green onions on top of the cheese. Mix everything together until the cheese melts into a thick spicy paste. Pour in the heavy cream or milk and stir until smooth and creamy. Add the cooked noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with fried egg, dumplings, mini sausages, extra green onions, and more chili oil if desired. Enjoy hot and creamy  #buldak #buldakramen #eat #food  #Foodie

Ultra Creamy Buldak Ramen 🍝🥟 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1–2 tbsp butter 2 cloves garlic (minced) 1 tbsp Kewpie mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet 1 tbsp chili oil ¾–1 cup heavy cream Mozzarella cheese Dumplings Sausages Green onions Sesame seeds Extra chili oil (for topping) Instructions Cook noodles until al dente, then drain and set aside. In a pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add Kewpie mayo, Buldak sauce, and powder packet. Mix well until it turns thick and glossy. Add chili oil and stir. Pour in heavy cream and mix until smooth, creamy, and slightly thickened (that rich orange color 🔥). Add noodles and toss until fully coated. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top and let it melt into the sauce. Add dumplings and sausages on top. Cover and let everything heat through.
